findings.problem: The helpers are described as 'updating in place if one already exists', but Binding_Create always AllocateBytes a fresh heap Binding; calling it while textbox->data.textbox.binding is non-NULL leaks the previous allocation. No live proof hits this (both attach exactly once), but the stated reuse contract is a trap for a future second-attach.
findings.fix: Specify the helper body explicitly: if textbox->data.textbox.binding is non-NULL, overwrite its fields in place (*binding = built) instead of calling Binding_Create again; only Binding_Create when the slot is NULL.
